en: A black and white photograph showing a quaint wooden railway station building named 'Tolgen,' surrounded by a small cluster of other wooden buildings and a train visible on the tracks behind. The landscape features rolling hills in the background, with scattered houses and forested areas. The overall scene is rural and tranquil, with a strong early 20th-century Scandinavian architectural style.
